routes.name: Rubble, Rails & Radio: Schöneberg South Loop
routes.summary: Rubble, rails and Cold War radio in southern Schöneberg: the Freedom Bell and Kennedy's town hall, Schöneberg station, Südkreuz, the Hans-Baluschek-Park, the Natur-Park Südgelände, the Insulaner rubble hill, the Grazer Damm estate, the painters' quarter, Innsbrucker Platz and the RIAS building.

routes.name: Power & Stone: Schöneberg → Gendarmenmarkt
routes.summary: Architecture and power: Wittenbergplatz station, the Villa von der Heydt, the Bendlerblock, the Philharmonie, the Potsdamer Platz traffic tower, Göring's Air Ministry, the Wall on Niederkirchnerstraße, Checkpoint Charlie, the Gendarmenmarkt and Hausvogteiplatz.

routes.name: Lions, Lanterns and Lakes
routes.summary: Parks and lakes in the Tiergarten: the Neuer See, the 1838 Lion Bridge, the gas lamp museum, the English Garden, Rousseau Island, Queen Louise's island, the Wagner monument and the old Axis embassies, home past Karl-Heinrich-Ulrichs-Straße.

routes.name: Radio Tower & Olympic Stadium: Westend Ride
routes.summary: Radio, racing and sport in the west: Olivaer Platz, Erich Kästner's Roscherstraße, the world's first trolleybus, Lunapark, the AVUS, the Radio Tower and ICC, the Haus des Rundfunks, Theodor-Heuss-Platz, Steubenplatz, the Kolbe Museum, the Corbusierhaus and the Olympic Stadium.

routes.name: Writers' Friedenau: Benjamin to Benn Loop
routes.summary: Literary Friedenau and Steglitz: Walter Benjamin and the Prinzregentenstraße synagogue, Max Frisch, Grass and Johnson on Niedstraße, Tucholsky, Kafka's two Steglitz homes, the Bierpinsel, Feuerbachstraße station, Rosa Luxemburg, the Ceciliengärten, Zuckmayer's bridge and Gottfried Benn.

routes.name: Science and the American Sector
routes.summary: Science and Cold War Dahlem: the Swedish Church, Volkspark Wilmersdorf and the Fennsee, Rüdesheimer Platz, Breitenbachplatz, Dahlem's 'German Oxford', the Domäne and St Anne's, the Allied Museum, Clay's headquarters, Kennedy at the Free University and the birthplace of nuclear fission.

routes.name: Turbines & Prison Walls: Moabit Island Loop
routes.summary: Industrial Moabit: Zoo station, the island of Moabit, Peter Behrens' AEG Turbine Factory, the Arminius Market Hall, the Moabit Criminal Court, the prison park, the Bolle dairy, the Hansaviertel and the zoo's Elephant Gate.

routes.name: Canal, Markets & Generals: Kreuzberg Loop
routes.summary: Canal and market Kreuzberg: Lützowplatz, the Bauhaus Archive, the Shell House, the New National Gallery, Möckernbrücke, the America Memorial Library, the Admiral Bridge, the Graefekiez, Südstern, Marheineke market hall, the generals of Yorckstraße and the Akazienkiez.

routes.name: Lakes & Villas: Schöneberg → Grunewald
routes.summary: Villas, lakes and Weimar history: Prager Platz, God's Power Station, Fehrbelliner Platz, the Thai Meadow, Max Planck's house, the Grunewald lake chain, the Rathenau memorial, the Hare's Leap and Track 17 at Grunewald station.

routes.name: Rails & the Red Island: Gleisdreieck Loop
routes.summary: Railway Schöneberg: Nollendorfplatz, the Sportpalast site, Park am Gleisdreieck, the Anhalter Bahnhof ruin, the Technikmuseum, the Yorck Bridges, Bowie's flat, the Red Island with Julius Leber and Marlene Dietrich, and the gasometer.

routes.name: Seattle: Mount Baker → Pioneer Square Commute
routes.summary: 3.6-mile commute to the office: Mount Baker Boulevard, Jimi Hendrix Park and the Northwest African American Museum, the I-90 Trail, Little Saigon, Chinatown–ID and the old railway stations.

routes.name: Charlottenburg Loop: Palace, Lake & Ku'damm
routes.summary: Old Charlottenburg: the Literaturhaus, Savignyplatz, the Deutsche Oper and 2 June 1967, the town hall, Charlottenburg Palace, the Lietzensee park, the Schaubühne and the Ku'damm.

routes.name: Seattle: Ballard → Pioneer Square Commute
routes.summary: A colleague's commute made fun: Bergen Place, Ballard Avenue, the Ballard Bridge and Fishermen's Terminal, the Elliott Bay Trail through Interbay, the Sculpture Park, Pike Place, the Great Wheel and Pioneer Square.

routes.name: To Padel Lankwitz via Friedenau
routes.summary: Your padel commute: Bundesallee through literary Friedenau, over the Friedenauer Brücke, past the Stadtpark Steglitz to the courts on Leonorenstraße.

routes.name: Airlift Trail: Schöneberg → Tempelhofer Feld
routes.summary: Allied and aviation Berlin: Winterfeldtplatz, the Allied Control Council building, the Grimms' churchyard, Viktoriapark's waterfall, the Airlift Memorial, then across the old runways of Tempelhofer Feld.

routes.name: Test Loop: Bavarian Quarter
routes.summary: Short 2.8 km shakedown loop from home — try out voice, GPS, music and pocket mode before the big ride.

routes.name: Schöneberg → Prenzlauer Berg Loop
routes.summary: Tiergarten, Brandenburg Gate, Museum Island, Kollwitzplatz, Mauerpark and the Wall on Bernauer Straße — mixing landmarks with quiet backstreets and park paths.
